newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ registered unemployment down slightly in Oct.
newsitem.headline: NZ registered unemployment down slightly in Oct.

text.p: The number of New Zealanders registered as unemployed fell by 227 to 153,906 in October, the Employment Service said on Thursday.
Employment Minister Wyatt Creech said he was pleased that both Maori unemployment and the number of long-term jobless continued to decline.
The number of registered unemployed stood at 147,752 in October 1995.

The figures reflect the number of people who have chosen to enrol with the Employment Service. The official measure of unemployment is the Household Labour Force Survey published by Statistics New Zealand. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
